Tom Becker: Anyone up for a quick belay-basics clinic after work today? 5:30-6:15 at the climbing wall. Low-stress, bring shoes if you have them. Reply with "yes" or "no".
Nina Gomez: yes 44d I'm rusty on lead belay, would love a refresher.
Leo Park: yes can demo ATC vs GriGri if needed.
Hannah Li: Maybe 914 I have a client call at 5:15 but could join at 5:45.
Tom Becker: 5:45 works, Hannah. We'll hold a 15-min intro + hands-on pairs.
ryan-runbot: Ryan Runbot uploaded an activity: "Lunchtime hill repeats" https://strava.example/runs/98765
Nina Gomez: Also, quick PSA: stairs challenge this week 3c33fb3c33fb who wants to pair up for a 10k steps target?
Leo Park: I'm in for steps challenge. Might do stair sprints Tue/Thu mornings.
Hannah Li: Steps challenge yes. If I'm late to belay clinic, will join the cool-down stretch session afterwards.
Tom Becker: Sweet. If anyone needs a harness, I have one in locker 2 (medium). Leave a note and I'll bring it down.
Nina Gomez: Thanks Tom! See you all at 5:30/5:45. If raining, fallback is brief technique demo in conf B + mobility drills.
